# How to Create Video Logo Removal with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to remove a logo from a video using an optional logo reference and motion mode, including setup, request fields, tool…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_video_logo_removal`

## Prompt

```text
Remove a logo from a video using an optional logo reference and motion mode.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_video_file_id` (required): Input video file id.
- `logo_file_id` (optional): Optional logo image file id used to build the logo mask session.
- `video_size` (optional): Optional original video size hint as [width, height].
- `logo_type` (optional): Logo motion mode for mask generation. Default: moving. Default: moving.
- `model_id` (optional): Video logo removal model id. Default: video-logo-removal-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
